def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    def collect(i,j,c):
        stack=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; res=[]
        while stack:
            a,b=stack.pop(); res.append((a,b))
            for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                x,y=a+da,b+db
                if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==c:
                    seen[x][y]=True; stack.append((x,y))
        return res
    comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=0 and not seen[i][j]:
                comps.append(collect(i,j,g[i][j]))
    marks={}  # kind -> idx -> set(colors)
    for comp in comps:
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        rr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2; cc=(min(cs)+max(cs))//2
        c=g[min(rs)][min(cs)]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        if len(comp)==1: continue
        if h>=w:  # tall: column marker
            marks.setdefault('col',{}).setdefault(cc,set()).add(c)
        else:      # wide: row marker
            marks.setdefault('row',{}).setdefault(rr,set()).add(c)
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for _,idx_,cols_ in marks.items():
        for idx,cols in cols_.items():
            if len(cols)>1: continue
            c=next(iter(cols))
            if idx_:  # is row/col marker index... we lost kind; fix structure
                pass
    # redo with proper key tuples
    return None

def load():

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[r[:] for r in g]
    def collect(i,j,c):
        stack=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
        while stack:
            a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
            for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                x,y=a+da,b+db
                if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==c:
                    seen[x][y]=True; stack.append((x,y))
        return cells
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=0 and not seen[i][j]:
                cells=collect(i,j,g[i][j])
                rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
                rr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2; cc=(min(cs)+max(cs))//2
                c=g[min(rs)][min(cs)]
                h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1

                else:         # square -> both
                    for r in range(H): res[r][cc]=c
                    for cc2 in range(W): res[rr][cc2]=c
    return res

def comps(g,minsize=2):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i,j]
            if v==0 or (i,j) in seen: continue
            st=[(i,j)]; cs=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop(); cs.append((a,b))
                for dx in(-1,0,1):
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x,y]==v and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
            rs=[c[0] for c in cs]; cls=[c[1] for c in cs]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cls),max(cls)
            area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            out.append((int(v),cs,bool(area==len(cs)),area,len(cs),r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return out

def comps(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=int(g[i,j])
            if v==0 or (i,j) in seen: continue
            st=[(i,j)]; cs=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop(); cs.append((a,b))
                for dx in(-1,0,1):
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and int(g[x,y])==v and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
            rs=[p[0] for p in cs]; cls=[p[1] for p in cs]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cls),max(cls)
            out.append((int(v),cs,(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)==len(cs)))
    return out

def f(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    res=[[gi[x][y] for y in range(W)] for x in range(H)]
    for v,px,solid in comps(gi):
        if len(px)<3 or not solid: continue
        r0=min(p[0] for p in px); r1=max(p[0] for p in px)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in px); c1=max(p[1] for p in px)
        cr,cc=(r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2
        for y in range(W): res[cr][y]=v
        for x in range(H): res[x][cc]=v
    return res

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    p=f(k); go=G[k+' output']
    print(k,'match:',p==go)
    bad=[(x,y,int(go[x][y]),p[x][y]) for x in range(len(go)) for y in range(len(go[0])) if p[x][y]!=go[x][y]]
    print('  mismatches:',bad[:10])

def comps2(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=int(g[i,j])
            if v==0 or (i,j) in seen: continue
            st=[(i,j)]; cs={(i,j)}; seen.add((i,j))
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                for dx in(-1,0,1):
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and int(g[x,y])==v and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); cs.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
            r0=min(p[0] for p in cs); c0=min(p[1] for p in cs)
